channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Kings open D.J. Smith era against Avalanche
item.description: Smith’s first test comes Monday against the NHL’s top team, Colorado.

item.title: Dodgers’ Mookie Betts ‘rewired’ and expecting a bounceback season
item.description: After the worst offensive season of his career, Betts said he "rewired" his swing with a back-to-basics approach and a much more relaxed offseason. Dodgers manager Dave Roberts expects an MVP-level bounceback from Betts.

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply in market trading after attacks in Middle East disrupt global energy supply
item.description: Traders were betting the supply of oil could slow or grind to a halt.

item.title: At least 22 people killed in Pakistan as protesters try to storm US Consulate
item.description: The violence came after the attack on Iran.

item.title: No. 2 UCLA women beat USC to polish off undefeated Big Ten season
item.description: Charlisse Leger-Walker matches her season high with 20 points as the Bruins rout the Trojans, 73-50, on Sunday. UCLA goes 18-0 in Big Ten play, completing the conference’s first undefeated women’s regular season in 11 years.

item.title: Lakers rookie Adou Thiero continuing to adjust to life between NBA, G League
item.description: Thiero, whom the Lakers drafted with the 36th pick of the 2025 NBA Draft, is turning heads with his high-flying display in the G-League, averaging 13.6 points per game in three games since Feb. 20.

item.title: Alexander: Is Charlisse Leger-Walker UCLA’s not-so-secret weapon?
item.description: The New Zealand native had a big scoring game in Sunday's win over USC women's basketball, but her contributions go way beyond the stat sheet.

item.title: Ducks edge Flames in shootout
item.description: Mason McTavish scores the deciding shootout goal for the Ducks, who remain perfect in shootouts this season, in a 3-2 win.

item.title: Clippers snap 3-game skid with win over Pelicans
item.description: Kawhi Leonard scores 23 points and Jordan Miller adds 19 in the 137-117 win Sunday. Leonard has scored 20 or more points in 37 consecutive games this season, the third-longest streak in franchise history, joining former Clippers great Bob McAdoo.

item.title: Lakers dismantle Kings behind Luka Doncic, LeBron James
item.description: Doncic scores a team-high 28 points and James adds 24 as the Lakers finish a back-to-back set with a 128-104 win.
